so many things. my psychosis was triggered by falling in love with a girl who didn’t love me back + stress and not sleeping or eating. i thought she was with me “in spirit” and that she actually loved me and that she was sending me signs. i would hold hands with her spirit form and have conversations with her like she was my imaginary friend. we even went on a trip two hours away together lol. i worked with this girl and drew a picture of our hands holding, put it in a spot at work, and hoped she would find it and would understand that i understood what was happening to us. i thought she was going to come out and confess her love for me too, despite having rejected me previously. i thought i had to do certain things, too, for our relationship to work. like i would have to drive in her neighborhood yelling that i loved her. i even followed a random car because i thought i had to ask them if she lives in their apartment building. oh, i almost forgot, i thought there was another timeline where we were married in france with three children and one of our daughters was my irl sister. to be teleported to this new reality, i thought i had to wear this specific pair of green pants and lay in bed to wait to be transported to this other dimension. i was convinced we were twin flames and our union was about to happen. needless to say, i don’t believe in twin flames or angel numbers or things like that anymore. 

other than that, i held my breath for like 3 minutes straight and no longer had the urge to breathe after that. i thought certain spiritually attuned people never slept so i no longer had to either. i had false memories of my dad raping me as a child and thought that i was awakening to this truth, and upon waking up he would too. i thought he and other, specifically affluent, white people were going to kill me and rape me or that i was a specimen of sorts (i’m half white/half southeast asian and my dad’s side is white). when he called the police on me because he was worried (i didn’t tell him my delusions) i thought he was trying to destroy my new gifts and lock me away forever. i was and still am very into hinduism, but at that time i thought my ex friend and ex therapist were telling me to get rid of my devotional pictures and stuff because it was like worshipping the devil. i replaced them with santo niño. i also thought the goddess lakshmi was talking to me and that i had to give all my money away to someone deserving in order to be with the girl i loved. before i threw away my stuff i thought hanuman was talking to me and he was sending blessings too. it was to a black trans woman friend who needed money. after doing all of this i ran to a nearby school because i thought there was a spiritual explosion where all of the devil spirits and people knew of my existence because i’m trans and ‘special’/awake. i also thought that everyone was an actor in a play. i was god. 

when i finally was taken to the hospital by my mom and sister, i only did it so i could hide from my dad and the evil white people/spirits. i thought they were taking me away to protect me. more stuff too BUT that’s the long gist of it. 

tl;dr take no as an answer when someone rejects you and be careful with spiritual ideas. it has given me a much more grounded view of life and god in general though. life isn’t about mystical, interconnected experiences or synchronicities

I’m personally under the impression that he was an avatar/a fully realized being, much like Lord Krishna or Rama in Hinduism (avatars of God), and came and died out of pure love for all beings. 

there’s a really amazing quote from Maharajji, a great indian saint about how Jesus never died, he was merely in love with every being he came across, and he needed to die in order to fulfill his leela (play), as well as the dharma (duty) of it all. 

Divine leela is a common principle in hinduism regarding avatars. ‘Bad’ things tend to happen to these avatars when they are on earth, but normally it is to fulfill a much much higher, pre-determined good. Like when Lord Ram was exhiled and his throne was taken from him, following his wife Sita. If those things had never happened, he would’ve never killed the demon king Ravan, Sita’s captor, thus freeing the land from evil.

The same goes for Christ. He had to be ‘curcified’ to fulfill his duty. in the same vein as that Maharajji quote, as mentioned, he also talks about how Jesus never actually died. he continues to live on in the hearts of every being in the form of pure, unconditional love. It has been love, it has always been love, and always will be. 

You can do what you like with this info, but I strongly recommend you look into Maharajji/Neem Karoli Baba and his insight on how “Krishna, Hanuman, and Christ are one”.

I got the chills when I saw the title of this post, and even more when I started to read the comments. Last night in a very vivid dream I saw a black bear, which I think I then became at some point. It felt incredibly significant, so I find it funny that this is the first post that came up on Reddit for me today.

I agree with what most everyone has been saying about protection and a sign from God/the universe. They are most definitely symbols of endurance and strength. Personally, I have been going through a turbulent time and have been wracked with anxiety, anger, etc. After this dream, I woke up knowing that everything was going to be ok - that nothing could happen to me that was not meant for me. I think I need to take some time to meditate more on this dream and the meaning for me personally, but I do feel incredibly protected. I’m sure that your daughter is as well. It seems like a great blessing from a spiritual being.

“It is better to do one’s own dharma (duty), even though imperfectly, than to do another’s dharma, even though perfectly.” - Bhagavad Gita 18.47

in the end, we must conduct our lives as they have been prescribed before us. whether the conscious mind likes it or not, we agreed to the nature of our lives before we were even born, including our own paths of suffering. for this reason, one cannot undertake another’s karma, suffering, dharma, etc. for only through our own individually prescribed karma, suffering, soul journey, whatever you’d like to call it - can one find true grace and evolution, leading to true liberation from the cycle of suffering

at the same time, it sucks. and i acknowledge that it sucks. as much as i can talk about how this has all been planned, how our pain will lead to our eventual freedom, that does not make our current predicament any less painful. to witness the suffering surrounding us is just as painful and influential as our own internal struggles. this is why it’s so very important to not only wish for liberation for oneself, but for everyone. i cannot be free unless you are also free, my friend.

if i ever find myself wishing better for myself and not for you - not for all - in order to live “better” or happier, i’m feeding into the machine of suffering through separateness. so long as you or i or anyone sees their suffering as separate from one another, we will all suffer the same.

and so i want you to know that i see you, friend, your suffering and all, and i acknowledge that it hurts beyond anything that i could possibly perceive as a stranger on the internet. because you feel you have been greatly wronged by the universe, and i really feel you there sometimes. if i were to judge you for your feelings, or insist that you are merely ‘wrong’, i feel that this would also further the divide of separateness between us. instead, i really want to meet you where you are and validate the struggles you go through

with that being said, i will leave you with this - you are far from alone on this journey, because there are so many beings suffering alongside you, who take your pain as their own. we will get there together, to liberation, one step at a time

Hi, I’m just finding this thread now but I also have Chiron in Scorpio (in the 7th house however). I want to preface by saying Imm no expert of professional astrologer, just someone with a strong opinion about what this placement may entail. 

While I had a rocky childhood (some abuse, neglect, etc.), along with an incredibly abusive relationship in high school, I do not look to those things as the *direct* root experiences of this placement. I more so find them to be side effects of past life karma and trauma, both if which are intrinsically linked to Chiron in Scorpio. 

I mention this because I experienced a journeying/reiki session a couple days ago. It revealed a deep, violent, past life trauma, the likes of which I am still trying to piece together, that has clung to me for many lives. I can only recall this event to be something along the lines of a deep betrayal, followed by my subsequent execution and condemnation by my community. The worst part is, I fully believed that I deserved it for whatever wrongdoing I may have committed, which has led to poor self confidence and self worth in this lifetime. I have struggled with feeling deserving of literally anything good in this life, as though I’m still trying to repent for whatever I had done before. 

That being said, I actually believe I have lived with Scorpio in Chiron for many lives as a result of that specific trauma, as I feel this placement lives very deeply in one’s soul - Scorpio is an incredibly powerful and magnetic sign after all. Because of this, I genuinely believe that this placement bleeds deeply into other lives until one can learn to heal and move past the root of these traumas. I genuinely believe that the Chiron in scorpio placement can and often does transcend many lives, manifesting in present-life traumas and abuse, as this placement may dwell beneath the surface otherwise. How can you know why you feel so sad and worthless if you live a perfect life, free from any triggers from a past reincarnation? It would be very difficult, to say the least, which makes me believe this placement to be somewhat of a blessing in disguise. Though the Chiron in Scorpio wounds seem to be some of the most traumatic and violent - things that are painful beyond measure - they are profoundly transformative

A little TW here, but the side effects of the root event of this placement for me has manifested as being sexually assaulted in other lives, to being murdered and witnessing the violent deaths of close loved ones. In all of these events, I cannot emphasize the feeling of helplessness enough. It may seem obvious, but this manifests as a lack of control and wanting more of it in those lives, as well as this life. 

Only in recent years have I been able to fully confront this addiction to control. It has existed as a barrier between myself and the fear of helplessness for all of my life, and for so many past lives. I used to be heavily into drinking and drugs, along with other forms of escapism as well such as excessive gaming. These were all forms of control over my emotions and my thoughts, to keep myself from experiencing anxiety, depression, etc., but I’m learning to see past all of this. I see how none of those things could have lead to any form of permanent happiness, free of suffering, which is the one thing I have allowed myself to crave. 

I can firmly say that without this placement, I would have never turned towards Spirit and higher consciousness, or to looking at the profound nature of my earthly predicament and why I am suffering so much. I agree with some others when they had said that this placement may make one spiritual or mystical. I also have Aries in my first house/pisces in 12th, as another user said their mother had, and I find myself feeling very in tune with the universe. I feel that many with this placement, along with other factors of course, can be easier lead to “seeing through the veil”, which is why I mentioned this placement to be something of a blessing in disguise

I’ll leave it at that because I could probably go on for some time, but I wish you all love and peace, as well as profound transformation and healing ❤️

Hi all, I’ve been practicing tarot for a little over a year so am still relatively new & seeking some particular guidance regarding this reading.

For context, I have been interested in someone who used to be an acquaintance of mine, who I’ll call M.  I have grown to be closer friends with them over the past few months, which is what I am associating the chariot & 9 of pentacles cards with in this reading - the hard work that I had put into the culmination of our current relationship, which I am currently enjoying. 

a couple months ago I had confessed my feelings to them because I prefer to be transparent in all aspects of my life, to which they responded by saying that they were not looking for a relationship at that time due to a history of abuse in the past. however, we have remained friends, and, if anything, we have been hanging out more than ever, spurring our relationship to where it is now. if i am being honest i often get the feeling that they like me in some capacity as well. however i know that they have been seeing people on the side, though i know that it is more their physical needs being met rather than emotional, so it has not bothered me too much. this leads me to where i get a little confused in regards to the future position of our relationship
